meta.name: treasury-and-liquidity
meta.description: Manages cash and liquidity — cash forecasting, runway, working capital, banking structure, and currency and counterparty exposure. Use this to build a cash forecast, extend runway, improve working capital, decide where cash should sit, or assess exposure to a bank, currency, or customer concentration.

copy.tagline: 预测现金流，优化营运资金，保障资金安全。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责企业资金管理，需要做现金规划和风险评估。
copy.tagline_en: Plan cash flows, optimize working capital, and manage liquidity risk.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage corporate treasury and need to plan cash flows and control liquidity risk.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按直接法逐周编制收付款现金预测,核对上周预测与实际差异;并基于情景测算 runway、梳理营运资金与银行/币种/客户敞口。
howto.when: 当你要求做现金预测、延长 runway 或改善营运资金等资金流动性相关任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我做未来13周的直接法现金预测。
say.note: 按周逐笔预测收款和付款。

say.text: 对比上周预测和实际发生,找出误差。
say.note: 滚动更新并核对准确性。

say.text: 分析一下应收账款账龄趋势。
say.note: 看趋势,不要只看平均值。

howto.what_en: Claude will build weekly direct cash forecasts of receipts and disbursements, compare last week's forecast to actuals, and run scenario-based runway, working capital, and exposure analyses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to forecast cash, extend runway, or improve working capital, or assess counterparty/currency exposures.

say_en.note: Forecasts receipts and payments by week.

say_en.text: Compare last week's forecast to actuals.

say_en.note: Watch the trend, not just the average.
